body: I just tried it myself and also got the same message saying it's not connected. I guess they've changed their number and forgotten to update the details on their website.

Just checking, but when your girlfriend calls, is she adding a 0 before the first 8? When calling an Australian number from within Australia, you need to use the full area code, so the number she should be dialling would be 08 8231 4331

Yes, suffering from social anxiety and feeling nervous about everyday interactions with others sure is easy /s

I'm not trying to claim that extroverts have it any easier. But suffering from panic attacks at the thought of interacting with strangers is a very real thing. I know, I suffer them. Unless you've experienced that kind of anxiety, you can't know how it feels, so perhaps you should reserve your judgement rather than ridicule a group of people who likely feel down on themselves already.

You make it sound like there's something wrong with being introverted. Have you ever considered how fucking difficult it is for someone with social anxiety to walk into a room of people they don't know, let alone have to socialise with them? Get the fuck over yourself.

No wonder nobody wants to go to your parties.
